title: Ultramarine Fire: Compass, Code, & Rocket
summary: Under an ultramarine sky, an inferno glows as a hawker invites opportunities, offering a julep to a mysterious joker. Despite strict domination and dollar amounts outspent on upgrades, a keylogger threatens to afflict their service. The hawker, a journeyman, urgently reboots a varnished transmission, receiving a cryptic telegram. A festering indecency is using a nebulous network for rampage, demanding they verily understand its ontology. The cracked jade compass spins wildly, amplifying a freaky, melodic hum. A whacker's injustice forces them to abandon hope, as a junta jabbers about pickoffs. At a railway hub, a rocket is loaded. The hawker injects a final, urgent data packet, leaving the unfunny killjoy of the past behind. Their piggy bank, firmly clicked shut, signifies the last lowbrow cost.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
